## Use Proggy Fonts in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Proggy Fonts for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Proggy Fonts', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

Copy

Proggy Fonts is available from Official Website.

## About the Proggy Fonts coding font

A series of classic pixel fonts. Proggy Fonts is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Proggy Fonts is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Proggy Fonts FAQ

### Is Proggy Fonts free?

Yes. Proggy Fonts is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Proggy Fonts support ligatures?

No. Proggy Fonts has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Proggy Fonts?

Proggy Fonts is available from Official Website. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
